## Product description
Introduce a touch of whimsy and elegance to your jewellery collection with this charming rabbit pendant necklace from MITHRAS CANADA. Inspired by Korean jewellery trends, this delightful piece features an adorable bunny pendant encrusted with sparkling cubic zirconia stones, giving it a dazzling, eye-catching finish. A tiny black stone accent serves as the rabbit's eye, adding a lifelike and endearing detail to the design. The pendant hangs gracefully from a gold-toned chain that alternates between classic link and sleek bar segments, creating a modern yet timeless aesthetic. The necklace fastens securely with an adjustable hook clasp, ensuring a comfortable and customised fit. Whether worn as an everyday accessory or gifted to a loved one for a special occasion, this rabbit necklace is a versatile and enchanting choice. It pairs beautifully with both casual and dressy outfits, making it a wonderful addition to any wardrobe. A perfect gift for animal lovers and jewellery enthusiasts alike.
